name: Nightfall
description: Night crosses the frame like the shadow line of a turning globe: a warm dusk dims the first clip into blue moonlight, then a rose dawn brings up the daylight on the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the night travels toward (x right, y up)

params.name: night
params.description: Width of the night between dusk and dawn, in frame heights

params.name: bow
params.description: Bow of the dusk and dawn lines

params.name: dusk
params.description: Light of the setting sun along the dusk line

params.name: dawn
params.description: Light of the rising sun along the dawn line

params.name: moon
params.description: Tint of the moonlight in the night
